REFERRAL LETTER

Patient Name: Fiona Sullivan
DOB: 09/01/1971
MRN: MRN-52702

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. Frank Avery, Juniper Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of an irregular pulse noted during a routine visit.

Fiona Sullivan is a 55-year-old woman with atrial fibrillation, hypertension, and hypothyroidism. An irregular pulse was noted during a routine visit at Juniper Family Practice.

She reports occasional brief awareness of a skipped beat but denies fainting, chest discomfort, or shortness of breath. I would appreciate your evaluation of the irregular pulse and recommendations for further management.

Patient is on warfarin.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. Frank Avery
Juniper Family Practice
